data.name: Polemista
data.detailed_description:
POLEMISTA is a tactical action game powered by Unreal Engine 5, blending tense stealth mechanics with explosive combat within a retro-styled cyberpunk world.

You are Agent K, a living weapon forged by a clandestine corporate program designed to protect Europe. But the program has been shut down. The project is abandoned. The assets are being liquidated. And you are an asset.

Now hunted by your creators, your only chance to clear your name and regain your freedom lies deep within the neon-soaked heart of the Tricity.

PLAY YOUR WAY

You possess enhanced abilities, but you are not invincible. City is crawling with private military contractors who shoot first and ask questions later.

  • Ghost in the Machine: Stick to the shadows. Use the environment to distract guards, hack security systems, and slip past patrols. If you are professional enough, they won't notice your presence.

  • Lethal Force: If stealth breaks, use your advanced training to engage. But be warned: gunfire attracts reinforcements, and you are alone behind enemy lines.

MODERN ENGINE, RETRO SOUL

Polemista captures the distinct atmosphere of 32-bit console classics.

  • PS1 Aesthetics: Authentic low-poly models, pixelated textures, and vertex wobble that will take you back to 1998.

  • Grim Atmosphere: Experience the dark, rainy vibe of the Polish coast rendered in a unique lo-fi cyberpunk style.

  • Fluid Control: While it looks retro, it plays with the precision of a modern shooter thanks to Unreal Engine 5.

KEY FEATURES

  • Nostalgic Graphics: A stylized visual trip back to the era of CRT TVs and memory cards.

  • Open-Ended Gameplay: Complete your objective quietly or with brute force.

  • Story of Betrayal: Unravel the mystery of the super-soldier program that created you.

data.short_description: Polemista is a tactical action game with stealth elements, set in a cyberpunk Polish coastal city. You are K, an enhanced super-soldier from a defunct corporate program designed to protect Europe. Now abandoned and hunted, you must find a way to clear your name and regain your freedom.

content_descriptors.notes: Polemista features mature content set in a dark cyberpunk world. Gameplay includes frequent combat involving firearms and melee weapons, resulting in pixelated blood and death animations. While the visual style is retro/low-poly, the themes are serious. The game depicts criminal activities, use of illegal drugs and alcohol, and strong language. The narrative also references sensitive topics, including suicide.
